text:
marta: Quick heads-up — RC build 2026.03.21 is stuck at the SBOM/signature step. Deploybot flagged an unverified signer on base image and the vulnerability scan still shows one infra-level advisory pending. Change window ends 18:00 PST. Options: wait (unknown ETA), pin base image digest and proceed limited canary, or carve out region (NA only) and delay EU. Thoughts?

samir: can you paste the deploybot output? which image and which advisory?

deploy-bot: [automated] build:rc-2026.03.21 | status: blocked | reason: sbom_signature_missing, vuln_scan: infra-high-AV-2026-045 | image: gcr.io/redwood/runtime:sha256:9f8a7c6b

ci-bot: vuln detail: AV-2026-045 (kernel-allocator) - appears in transitive base packages; severity: high; reproducible: yes; suggested mitigation: kernel patch or CVE backport; workaround: runtime sandbox flag reduces exploit path (performance cost ~3-5%). SBOM signer: cosign timestamp missing due to artifact signer outage (internal keyserver incident).

alex: if signer outage might be minutes->hours. For availability I'd prefer NA-only canary pinned to the digest and a restricted traffic route. We can enable runtime sandbox flag to reduce risk for the canary. Rollback plan: immediate unpublish and revert to rc-2026.03.20 if telemetry spikes.

jen: legal wants the release notes to call out the temporary mitigation and planned followup. Also need an approval note for any carveout. @legal-bot can you confirm wording?

legal-bot: we need: (1) statement that artifact signature was pending at deploy time, (2) that artifact provenance will be attached post-signing, (3) any customers on EU carveout must be notified. Approvals: engineering+security signoff required for carveout.

ops: ops: if we do NA-only carveout we need the route rule: `traffic.route = region=="us-*" && header.x-canary==true` and feature flag `canary_block_nonus=false` — I can apply that. Also will monitor latency/errors for 2h.

marta: concrete proposal: timebox 2 hours for signer evidence (cosign timestamp). If evidence appears, proceed global canary. If not, proceed NA-only canary pinned to digest with runtime sandbox flag enabled, and a 30-minute low-traffic ramp, then 2h monitor. If any anomaly -> immediate rollback. We'll add release notes and a follow-up ticket to attach provenance and run a small hotpatch if kernel backport needed.

samir: fine by me. A couple of implementation notes: 1) to pin use deploybot pin command, 2) add policy to disallow EU traffic. Example command: ```
# pin image and add temporary reason
deploybot pin --service=runtime --image=gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:9f8a7c6b --reason="temp-sbom-signing-lag" --expires=4h
```

alex: we'll also enable sandbox flag with config: `RUNTIME_SANDBOX=1` in the canary config. I'll open a quick PR to the runtime rollout config and link it here.

jen: for release notes snippet — put this in the changelog under Security/Compliance: "Canary rollout for rc-2026.03.21 restricted to North America due to signer service delay; temporary runtime sandbox enabled. Artifact will be re-signed and provenance attached once signer service is restored. Customers in EU will see delayed availability."

Action items:
- marta: kick off pin if timebox expires (you).
- alex: PR for sandbox + route rule (you).
- ops: apply traffic carveout and monitor (you).
- samir: run quick smoke fuzz and add canary perf checks (you).
- legal-bot: prepare customer-facing wording and signoff if carveout used (you).
- ci-bot: continue polling signer service and post cosign evidence to thread (you).

deploy-bot: acknowledged. If pinned, will schedule canary rollout at next deploy window (10m after pin).

ci-bot: signer status: polling... (last check +0m) -> signer service degraded, retrying in 60s.

marta: ok starting 2h clock now :hourglass_flowing_sand:. If no cosign evidence by 20:10 PST I'll trigger the NA-only pin and rollout.

ci-bot: signer update +15m: cosign timestamp still missing.

samir: small note — when we pin, include image digest in release notes and the artifact ticket so we can track repros.

marta: agreed. I'll draft the release notes now and update the ticket. Draft snippet: "rc-2026.03.21 — NA canary only; runtime sandbox enabled due to signer outage; artifact signed post-deploy; monitoring in place; follow-up hotpatch ticket if CVE requires."

legal-bot: OK on wording, pending engineering signoff for carveout.

ci-bot: signer update +1h30m: cosign evidence still not available. No ETA from keyserver team.

marta: timebox expired. Triggering pin and NA-only canary now.

marta: `deploybot pin --service=runtime --image=gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:9f8a7c6b --reason="temp-sbom-signing-lag" --expires=4h` -> :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: pinned image gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:9f8a7c6b | expires in 4h | scheduled canary rollout in 10m | mode: NA-only (route rule applied)

ops: applied route rule and feature flag. Low-traffic ramp starting now. Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/boards/canary-rc-2026.03.21

samir: smoke checks running, no immediate errors in first 5 mins. CPU bump expected due to sandbox (~4%).

alex: PR merged for sandbox flag and route rule.

jen: releasing release_notes draft to docs for legal review: https://confluence.redwood/releases/rc-2026.03.21-notes (please add final customer wording).

ci-bot: signer update +2h25m: cosign evidence posted for sha256:9f8a7c6b (timestamped). Will attach provenance to artifact in the ticket.

marta: signer back online -> plan: after 4h pin expiry we'll unpin and promote global canary with signed artifact. For now keep NA-only until we've verified provenance attach.

legal-bot: confirm customers notified where required. I'll send the EU notification draft in 30m.

ops: leaning OK. Will keep monitoring until global promote. :thumbsup:

marta: thanks everyone. Closing thread but will update the release ticket with final notes and provenance link."
